Acquiror Common Stock issued under Exchange Ratio; Cash in lieu of fractional shares of Acquiror Common Stock; Dividends and other distributions payable after the Merger.
Each outstanding share of Company Common Stock (excluding Cancelled Shares) will be converted into the right to receive a number of Acquiror Common Stock shares equal to the Exchange Ratio; the exact numeric Exchange Ratio is not provided in the excerpt. Fractional shares are paid in cash under Section 2.2, and the Exchange Ratio may be adjusted under Section 1.6(d).
